queries.label: Recharge Details
queries.sql_template: SELECT "#user_id" AS "User ID", "pay_amount" AS "Recharge Amount" FROM (SELECT "#user_id", "pay_amount", IF((("#zone_offset" IS NOT NULL) AND ("#zone_offset" >= -30) AND ("#zone_offset" <= 30)), date_add('second', CAST((/* settlement timezone = spec.timezone.offset, 8 in this example -- replace with the actual project value */ 8 - "#zone_offset") * 3600 AS integer), "#event_time"), "#event_time") AS shifted_time FROM ta.v_event_2 WHERE "$part_event" = 'payment' AND "$part_date" BETWEEN date_format(date('{{date}}') - INTERVAL '1' DAY, '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date('{{date}}') + INTERVAL '1' DAY, '%Y-%m-%d')) t WHERE date(shifted_time) = date('{{date}}') LIMIT 50000
